title: VA-01: GAO-25-106969 Recommendation 2 implementation artifact and milestone record
summary: GAO-25-106969 Recommendation 2 remains Open. Its normalized follow-through state is Promised; the record separates the named artifact, visibility, milestone, GAO review state, and remaining gap.
key_findings: Current GAO status: Open; status period: February 2026.

Response artifact: Revised VHA enterprise risk-management function. VA said restructuring would change oversight and planned a multi-year implementation; GAO still requires incorporation of all leading practices.
Artifact availability: Planned actions described on the GAO page.
Named milestone: September 2028; milestone state: Future monitor.
GAO review state: Implementation not yet demonstrated.
Remaining gap: A risk-management function that fully incorporates all GAO leading practices.

Continuation rule: Recheck for interim policies and evidence before the September 2028 target. Preserve VA-01 as the parent crosswalk; do not translate an artifact, promise, submission, or GAO review into implementation, closure, or operating outcome.
why_it_matters: Recommendation-specific follow-through makes it possible to distinguish a promise, an available artifact, a submission, GAO review, partial addressing, implementation, closure, and later operating outcomes.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves VA-01 as the parent crosswalk.
Records public artifact availability without treating availability as sufficiency or implementation.
Keeps named dates as monitors that do not pause the active content queue.
evidence_limits: A promised milestone is a monitor, not implementation evidence.
An agency artifact or submission is not implementation unless its scope satisfies the recommendation and the official record supports that conclusion.
Open – Partially Addressed is an official recommendation status, not the Phase 56F Partially Closed entity evidence state.
Recommendation closure would not by itself establish operating performance, readiness, safety, savings, value, or causation.
